title: WakeMark quickstart
description: Connect X, sync bookmarks, and start searching your library in a few minutes.

hero.title: Quickstart
hero.subtitle: The essential flow: sign in, connect X, sync, then explore your organized library.

overview.title: Overview
overview.p1: Most people are productive in WakeMark after four steps: create an account, connect X, run the first sync, then browse or search the dashboard. Optional steps — importing older history, installing the extension, or connecting Notion — come after that.

steps.title: Basic workflow
steps.step1Body: Sign up at wakemark.app with email or your preferred login method. You land on the dashboard once authentication finishes.
steps.step2Body: Open Settings and connect your X account through the official OAuth flow. WakeMark only requests read access to bookmarks — never your password.
steps.step3Body: Click Sync on the bookmarks board. Your newest saves appear within a minute. AI tagging and summaries run in the background; a short banner may show while organization finishes.
steps.step4Body: Use search, filters, and tags to find posts. Try Ask AI for questions across your saves, or open Lists and Digests from the sidebar when you want curated views.

optional.title: Recommended next steps
optional.importBody: The first API sync only brings in your newest ~20 bookmarks. Use the Chrome extension to import your full X history.
optional.extensionBody: Search bookmarks from the toolbar, run history import, and use Ask AI from the popup or side panel without opening the website.
optional.exportBody: Download your library as files, or connect Notion to keep an AI-ready database in sync.
optional.mcpBody: Give Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor secure access to search your bookmarks from inside your AI workflow.

items.sync: Sync again anytime you want the latest saves — there is no bookmark limit.
items.tags: Tags appear automatically; you do not need to configure categories first.
items.trial: Trial accounts can sync a limited number of bookmarks. Upgrade when you need the full library.
